subject: Controlled public edition of the 1987 Sun Park Owners' Statutes and 2008 CEXP governance and operating-transfer source materials
verified_findings: The located 1987 source instrument is an Owners' Community / horizontal-property record with an operative tourism-purpose provision.
The located 2008 compilation records a collective CEXP origin and a direct operating-transfer instrument from Montelanza to CEXP, stated to take effect on 27 May 2008.
The located sources distinguish the property-community and operating-community layers; they do not by themselves identify a later Costa Papagayo debtor or establish a debtor substitution.
not_established: universal CEXP mandate or uninterrupted operation
validity or amount of a Costa Papagayo liability
automatic LPB succession to a Community obligation
extension of LPB's Concurso 36/2012 to CEXP, the Owners' Community, Matkator or third-party property
open_evidence: certified 2008 meeting, CEXP statutes, governing-body authority, transfer and annexes
Costa Papagayo ledger, invoices, EUR25,000 payment receipt and any agreement
complete execution record and alleged debtor-substitution basis

publication_boundary: The public repository carries the controlled digital edition, not the unredacted forwarded scans. Any later public image edition requires document-by-document privacy, provenance and redaction review.
